name: unsafe fn from_raw_in (ptr : * const T , alloc : A) -> Self
rule: For safety, ptr must still own its potential weak reference, which Weak::from_raw_in takes ownership of; pointers created by Weak::new are excepted from weak-reference ownership because they own nothing.
api: impl < T : ? Sized , A : Allocator > alloc::rc::Weak < T , A > { unsafe fn from_raw_in (ptr : * const T , alloc : A) -> Self }
expression: The supplied DSL cannot express weak-reference ownership or the Weak::new exception.
